subject: Re: Request for VM scan cadence, SLA and CVE closure attestation
messages:
From: Maya Patel <m.patel@acme-fin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-09-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for VM evidence: cadence + closure attestation

Ben —

Thanks for the call earlier. Our security review needs a short package showing Redwood's vulnerability management practices for our procurement team: specifically:

- Current authenticated/internal scan cadence for prod and non-prod
- SLA for critical/important CVE remediation and examples of recent closures
- A signed attestation or email from an authorized owner indicating the timeline and that the referenced CVEs are closed (or remediated to mitigated residual risk)

If possible, please include the latest scan report and a remediation log that ties CVEs to PRs or mitigation actions. We need this by the end of next week (2026-09-27) to keep the contract timeline.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Senior InfoSec Analyst
Acme Financial

Attachment: request-form-acme-20260920.pdf (form)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for VM evidence: cadence + closure attestation

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the clear list. I'll assemble the package and include a formal attestation from our Security & Compliance lead. Preliminary details below so you have context while we prepare the files: 

- Scan cadence: authenticated Nessus/Qualys scans run weekly against non-prod and twice-weekly against production instances (nightly light scans for high-change services), with monthly full credentialed scans for both prod/non-prod.
- SLA: Critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9.0 or AV:N/PR:N/AC:L) targeted for 72-hour remediation or compensating control; High/Important (CVSS 7.0-8.9) targeted within 14 days; Medium/Low tracked and remediated per quarterly cadence.
- Recent closure sample: CVE-2026-1423 (priority: Critical) patched and deployed 2026-09-12, verification scan passed 2026-09-13; evidence will be included in the remediation log.

We have the latest consolidated scan (redwood-vm-scan-20260924.pdf) and a remediation CSV (cve-remediation-log-202608-202609.csv) that maps CVE to PRs, deploy IDs and verification scan results. I'll include the signed attestation and an SLA matrix spreadsheet.

Target delivery: EOD 2026-09-24. If that works for you I'll send the package to this thread.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Security Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: vm-summaries-placeholder.txt (note)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for VM evidence: cadence + closure attestation

Ben —

Looping you and Rachel in to sign off on the attestation language. Maya asked for an "authorized owner" attestation: that should come from Compliance or Security leadership. I can approve the wording but Rachel should sign the final attestation copy. Draft wording below — please confirm edits and I'll route for signature: 

--- draft attestation ---
To whom it may concern,

This attests that Redwood Inference conducts vulnerability scanning and remediation per the attached schedules and SLAs. The specific CVEs referenced in the remediation log dated August–September 2026 have been remediated and verified as closed in our production environment as of the verified timestamps. Where remediation required compensating controls, those controls are documented in the remediation log.

Signed,
[Name], Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
--- end draft ---

Rachel — can you review and confirm signatory name? Also note we should not include internal ticket comments that reference root-cause PII (keep logs sanitized).

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Sales Ops (approving evidence requests)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, security@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-09-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for VM evidence: cadence + closure attestation

Maya —

Thanks for your patience. Per the timeline below, attached is the vulnerability management package for Acme Financial. This email serves as the formal attestation of remediation for the items in the remediation log.

Summary: 
- Scan cadence: production credentialed scans: twice-weekly; nightly light scans; monthly full credentialed scans. Non-prod: weekly credentialed scans, monthly full.
- SLA commitments: Critical — 72 hours; High — 14 days; Medium/Low — tracked and remediated per quarterly cadence. See attached vm-sla-matrix-sep2026.xlsx for formal SLA table.
- CVE remediation: see cve-remediation-log-202608-202609.csv showing CVE IDs, affected component, PR/CL references, deployment IDs, verification-scan timestamp and current status. Notable closure: CVE-2026-1423 (Critical) patched and verified closed on 2026-09-13.

Attestation (signed):
I, Rachel Kim, Head of Security & Compliance at Redwood Inference, attest that the remediation actions listed in the attached remediation log were completed and verified in production on the timestamps indicated. Where full remediation was not possible within the documented timeframe, compensating controls were applied and are documented in the log.

Signed electronically,
Rachel Kim
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: redwood-vm-scan-20260924.pdf; cve-remediation-log-202608-202609.csv; vm-sla-matrix-sep2026.xlsx

Please confirm receipt and let us know if you'd like an annotated walk-through of the remediation entries.

Regards,
Rachel
